reuse_rule: Earlier identical candidate/seed may be reused only when its early stopping completed before its old cap; all cap-truncated search and final fits rerun with uniform raised caps.
ranking: All48 first-seed scores, top4 at3 search seeds, ascending candidate tie break; deterministic LR1 fit; all10 final seeds.
gate: All60 selections complete; selected final fits must satisfy early stopping; any newly selected outer continuous endpoint improving three-search-seed mean by>0.0005 over previous selection requires additional review. Fixed primary metric and margins unchanged.
normality_review: Retain fixed10 seeds if development precision half-width<=.0025, upper-variance planning power>=.8 and Shapiro p>=.01; this diagnostic is not proof of normality.
endpoint_policy: Interior expanded candidates supported by two-point outward probes; natural parameter bounds and finite capacity categories reported separately. C plateau described numerically.
